## What's changed

- Fixed paired players showing an empty Home screen and falling back to pairing when large network-mounted libraries took too long to prepare.
- Made Home, Library, and local discovery artwork use the server's scanned media index instead of repeatedly probing remote media folders during player requests.
- Added a prepared Home response cache that automatically refreshes when watch progress or the local library index changes.
- Preserved poster, backdrop, season, and episode artwork with a reliable poster fallback when an optional artwork variant is unavailable.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
